Fixpoint open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e_5:exp) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6}: exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => e_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => e_5
        | inright _ => e_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | e_top => e_top
  | (e_lit i5) => e_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => e_abs A (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e) B
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => e_fixpoint (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e) A
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => e_merge (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => e_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e) A
end.

Fixpoint open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec (k:nat) (ee_5:dexp) (ee__6:dexp) {struct ee__6}: dexp :=
  match ee__6 with
  | (de_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => de_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => ee_5
        | inright _ => de_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (de_var_f x) => de_var_f x
  | de_top => de_top
  | (de_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (de_abs ee) => de_abs (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec (S k) ee_5 ee)
  | (de_app ee1 ee2) => de_app (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee1) (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee2)
  | (de_merge ee1 ee2) => de_merge (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee1) (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee2)
  | (de_fixpoint ee) => de_fixpoint (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec (S k) ee_5 ee)
end.

Definition open_exp_wrt_exp e_5 e__6 := open_exp_wrt_exp_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Definition open_dexp_wrt_dexp ee_5 ee__6 := open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec 0 ee__6 ee_5.

+  intros e e' Hstep.
+  induction Hstep as [A e D v v' Hlc Hv Hred | v A v' Hv Hred |
+                      e1 e2 e1' Hlc Hstep IH | v1 e2 e2' Hv Hstep IH |
+                      e1 e2 e1' Hlc Hstep IH | v1 e2 e2' Hv Hstep IH |
+                      e A e' Hstep IH | e A Hlc]; simpl.
+  - rewrite erase_anno_open.
+    pose proof (erase_anno_lc _ Hlc) as Habs.
+    eapply dstep_star_trans.
+    + apply (dstep_star_context (de_app (de_abs (erase_anno e)))).
+      * intros u u' Hu. apply DStep_appr; [now apply DVal_abs | exact Hu].
+      * exact (typed_reduce_erasure _ _ _ Hred).
+    + eapply star_step; [apply DStep_beta | apply star_refl].
+      * exact Habs.
+      * exact (typed_reduce_result_value _ _ _ Hred).
+  - exact (typed_reduce_erasure _ _ _ Hred).
+  - apply (dstep_star_context (fun e => de_app e (erase_anno e2))); [| exact IH].
+    eauto using DStep_appl, erase_anno_lc.
+  - apply (dstep_star_context (de_app (erase_anno v1))); [| exact IH].
+    eauto using DStep_appr, erase_anno_value.
+  - apply (dstep_star_context (fun e => de_merge e (erase_anno e2))); [| exact IH].
+    eauto using DStep_mergel, erase_anno_lc.
+  - apply (dstep_star_context (de_merge (erase_anno v1))); [| exact IH].
+    eauto using DStep_merger, erase_anno_value.
+  - exact IH.
+  - rewrite erase_anno_open.
+    eapply star_step; [apply DStep_fix | apply star_refl].
+    exact (erase_anno_lc _ Hlc).
+Qed.
